mission.title: Rule of Thumb
mission.description: Plant a blue pill in Kalt Corporation's production pipeline.

npc.say: Handing out blue pills? A very worthwhile pursuit. Some might even consider it... fun.

phase.briefing:
The situation with the commandos you encountered earlier is quite... perplexing. We will wait until further encounters dictate our actions. In the meantime, we must counter Zion's irresponsible recruitment procedures.
If they feel entitled to conduct mass unsolicited emails, we will balance their efforts with our own.
Proceed to the location indicated and collect a blue pill from Agent Lee.

enter.say: A single blue pill? I wonder what Gray has in mind.

objective.text: Get the blue pill from Agent Lee

talk.say: {player}. You may take the blue pill from me.

done.say: Time to head out and get your next waypoint.

phase.briefing:
Your target today will be the research facilities of Kalt Corporation. This company is run by an Exile who has not proven entirely... cooperative in the past. You need to gain access to their facilities.
Your HUD has been updated with the coordinates of a security office. Procure an access card to the Kalt facilities.

enter.say: All right, the access card computer is in there.
Looks like Kalt's contracted Dame White's "White Security" team for extra muscle. They're a tough group -- you ready?
Looks like you need an access code off one of the guards.

objective.text: Get the access code from the White Security Guard

done.say: That looks like an access code for the computer system!

objective.text: Use the access code on the access card computer

done.say: Nice. You can snag the access card and get out of there now.

objective.text: Get the access card from the computer

done.say: One access card... check! Looks like time to pay Kalt Corporation a little visit.

phase.briefing:
Very good. That card will allow you to gain entry to one of Kalt Corporation's research facilities. They are currently developing a new antidepressant.
Break in, remove the prototype pill from their storage, and replace it with the blue pill.

enter.say: This is the place. The prototype pill should be in a container somewhere in there.

objective.text: Remove the prototype pill from the container

done.say: There's the prototype medicine. Ready to make the switch?
All right, now put the blue pill in there.

objective.text: Put the blue pill in the container

done.say: All right, that's it. Look out for security on your way out!

mission.finish:
The... efficiency of this plan pleases me. The blue pill has been planted in their production pipeline. This drug will be approved and on the shelf of every drugstore in the City very shortly.
Your assistance has been quite beneficial, {player}.
